scope: Second-dataset replication of the CIFAR multi-source and fine-tuning studies on four-band EuroSAT CNN6 baselines, with every rule fixed before any EuroSAT compression outcome: same policies, removal levels, ridge alpha, random-set RNG formula, fit/check halves and fine-tuning budget as configs/multisource_compensation.json and configs/finetune_compression.json. Quaternion victims: nested fit-only pairwise selection (full-map residual times outgoing kernel energy), as in the CIFAR internal study. No official-test inference; no novelty claim.
